mapper.select: SELECT ktr.kb_transfer_request_id, ktr.idempotency_key, ktr.source_kb_account_id, ktr.destination_kb_account_id, ktr.amount, ktr.source_balance_after, ktr.destination_balance_after, ktr.transaction_category, ktr.transfer_status, ktr.kb_transaction_id, ktr.failure_code, ktr.failure_message, ktr.group_user_id, ktr.settlement_receiver_id, ktr.round_id, ktr.requested_at, ktr.completed_at, ktr.updated_at FROM kb_transfer_requests ktr INNER JOIN rounds r ON r.round_id = ktr.round_id INNER JOIN `groups` g ON g.group_id = r.group_id INNER JOIN group_users gu ON gu.group_user_id = ktr.group_user_id AND gu.group_id = g.group_id AND gu.user_id = #{userId} WHERE ktr.kb_transfer_request_id = #{kbTransferRequestId} AND ktr.round_id = #{roundId} AND ktr.transaction_category = 'SETTLEMENT' AND g.user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_transfer_requests SET transfer_status = 'PENDING', source_balance_after = NULL, destination_balance_after = NULL, kb_transaction_id = NULL, failure_code = NULL, failure_message = NULL, completed_at = NULL WHERE kb_transfer_request_id = #{kbTransferRequestId} AND transaction_category = 'SETTLEMENT' AND transfer_status = 'FAILED'
mapper.select: SELECT kb_transfer_request_id, idempotency_key, source_kb_account_id, destination_kb_account_id, amount, source_balance_after, destination_balance_after, transaction_category, transfer_status, kb_transaction_id, failure_code, failure_message, group_user_id, settlement_receiver_id, round_id, requested_at, completed_at, updated_at FROM kb_transfer_requests WHERE kb_transfer_request_id = #{kbTransferRequestId}

SELECT ktr.kb_transfer_request_id, ktr.amount, ktr.transaction_category, ktr.transfer_status, ktr.kb_transaction_id, ktr.failure_code, ktr.failure_message, ktr.settlement_receiver_id, ktr.round_id, ktr.requested_at, ktr.completed_at, ktr.updated_at FROM kb_transfer_requests ktr INNER JOIN rounds r ON r.round_id = ktr.round_id INNER JOIN group_users gu ON gu.group_id = r.group_id AND gu.user_id = #{userId} AND gu.group_user_id = ktr.group_user_id WHERE ktr.round_id = #{roundId} AND ktr.transaction_category = 'SETTLEMENT' ORDER BY ktr.requested_at DESC, ktr.kb_transfer_request_id DESC

SELECT kb_transfer_request_id, idempotency_key, source_kb_account_id, destination_kb_account_id, amount, source_balance_after, destination_balance_after, transaction_category, transfer_status, kb_transaction_id, failure_code, failure_message, group_user_id, settlement_receiver_id, round_id, requested_at, completed_at, updated_at FROM kb_transfer_requests WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_transfer_requests ( idempotency_key, source_kb_account_id, destination_kb_account_id, amount, transaction_category, transfer_status, group_user_id, settlement_receiver_id, round_id ) VALUES ( #{idempotencyKey}, #{sourceKbAccountId}, #{destinationKbAccountId}, #{amount}, #{transactionCategory}, #{transferStatus}, #{groupUserId}, #{settlementReceiverId}, #{roundId} )
mapper.select: SELECT balance FROM kb_accounts WHERE kb_account_id = #{kbAccountId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_transfer_requests SET transfer_status = 'SUCCESS', kb_transaction_id = #{kbTransactionId}, source_balance_after = #{sourceBalanceAfter}, destination_balance_after = #{destinationBalanceAfter}, failure_code = NULL, failure_message = NULL, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE kb_transfer_request_id = #{kbTransferRequestId} AND transfer_status = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_transfer_requests ( idempotency_key, source_kb_account_id, destination_kb_account_id, amount, transaction_category, transfer_status, failure_code, failure_message, group_user_id, settlement_receiver_id, round_id, completed_at ) VALUES ( #{idempotencyKey}, #{sourceKbAccountId}, #{destinationKbAccountId}, #{amount}, #{transactionCategory}, #{transferStatus}, #{failureCode}, #{failureMessage}, #{groupUserId}, #{settlementReceiverId}, #{roundId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE transfer_status = CASE WHEN transfer_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN transfer_status ELSE VALUES(transfer_status) END, failure_code = CASE WHEN transfer_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN failure_code ELSE VALUES(failure_code) END, failure_message = CASE WHEN transfer_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN failure_message ELSE VALUES(failure_message) END, completed_at = CASE WHEN transfer_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN completed_at ELSE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP END
